tags.definition: Publishing and enforcing a canonical StratifiedKFold split, seed, row order, and class order so all agents produce comparable leak-free OOF predictions.
Saving and exchanging out-of-fold and test probability arrays as .npy files with fixed shapes, row order, and class order for downstream stacking.
Naming and filtering blend, stack, ensemble, meta, and submission outputs so they are not accidentally ingested as base-model OOF features and cause circular leakage.
Coordinating non-overlapping GPU model lanes by claiming specific architectures, posting lock/release signals, and limiting concurrent heavy fine-tuning jobs.
Building TF-IDF word/char n-gram features with LogisticRegression, NB-SVM, ComplementNB, SGD, SVM, and related linear/NB baselines including case and feature-space searches.

Fine-tuning pretrained language models such as BERT, RoBERTa, DeBERTa, XLNet, ELECTRA, ERNIE, MPNet, BART, DistilBERT, and ALBERT with specified epochs, learning rates, sequence lengths, precision, and regularization.
Comparing per-fold best-epoch selection against averaging predictions across multiple epochs, including late-epoch averaging for adversarially trained models.
Running the same architecture with multiple random seeds and averaging their predictions to reduce transformer seed variance and improve a single base model's OOF score.
Adding Fast Gradient Method embedding perturbation with a second backward pass during transformer fine-tuning to reduce overfitting and improve validation log loss.
Using a per-fold teacher that never sees the validation fold to generate confident test-set soft labels for student-model self-training without OOF leakage.
Applying temperature scaling or related calibration to base-model probabilities before blending or stacking so overconfident models are weighted fairly.
Training meta-learners on concatenated base probabilities/log-probabilities plus handcrafted stylometric text features using LR, MLP, or LightGBM stackers.
Fitting arithmetic, geometric, greedy, or meta-combine weights and checking them with nested or honest fold-wise validation to quantify and control stacking optimism.
Coordinating a single writer for final_solution, preventing write races, verifying submission ids/format/probability sums, and packaging reproducible code and README artifacts.
Analyzing decorrelated errors across model families and prioritizing new architectures, scales, and genuinely diverse base models over repeated stacker tweaks.
Reporting weak models or failed feature families and stopping GPU jobs whose expected score gain is poor relative to their compute cost.
